status: Prototype reviewed: Blink and TiredEyes adopted as two UV shader controls; mouth/Smile portion remains unadopted.
scope: Static raw GLB imported by Godot, shader/code only. No raw mesh, UV or source image edits.
elapsed_scope: Bounded investigation started about 16:44 JST; completed about 17:07 JST, including a pause for priority rigged-scene integration.
findings: Both eyes were located by a front ray and barycentric UV interpolation. Each eye lies within one face atlas island; blink removes the painted iris/white and draws a closed eyelid.
Below the nose and at the left mouth corner, adjacent 3D points jump about 460 source texels across UV islands. A single affine UV ellipse/curve breaks at these seams.
Dense front-ray tracing, splitting UV discontinuities and simplifying each UV run produces continuous native shader mouth lines without drawing across unrelated atlas islands.
Original mouth uses 3 UV runs/8 simplified segments, smile uses 2 runs/14 segments, tired uses 4 runs/11 segments.
Open, blink, smile and tired produce distinct static GPU renders. Blink was also inspected at -30 degrees.

visual_assessment.blink: Viable candidate: painted iris is hidden and one eyelid line remains. No invented blend-shape support.
visual_assessment.smile_tired: Technically viable and distinguishable. Current thin procedural mouth and skin-fill/blush appearance remain artificial in a 1000px closeup; retain as art-review prototypes.
visual_assessment.recommendation: Root accepted Blink/TiredEyes only. Keep mouth shader out of the game; pursue actual geometry-based mouth/Smile controls and review LOD seams separately.

unverified: Production rig deformation and head-gaze movement with this shader
All three runtime LODs and transitions
Sleep and conversation timing in the actual game
Readability at the normal town camera and multi-resident GPU cost
Eye look-left/look-right, eyebrow/sad control and speech mouth articulation

production_followup.verified: Sleep forces closure, wake opens, periodic blink/fatigue drive two real controls, LOD keeps owned shader/atlas/values; 31 GPU checks passed.
production_followup.quality_issue: Forced closeup reveals preexisting decimated-LOD seam cracks; reported for mesh repair. This is separate from the nontransparent eye shader.
